description: #56: the PR fixer's level 1. Claude Code through the cultureagent claude bridge (0.15.0) on spark, running as its own unprivileged account (culture-claude-fixer, its own claude login); sandbox workspace-write, one try at a time on the claude-spark pool. Commits locally and never pushes: the hand-off carries its commits to spark2's gate, and qwen-reviewer reviews them.
name: PR fixer (Claude Code, level 1)
